_comment: Declare which folders hold PRODUCTION source. Members under these paths (or whose library folder name matches) are marked authoritative; when the same member name exists elsewhere with different content, queries prefer the authoritative copy and say so. Paths are matched case-insensitively as prefixes or as a folder name.
_external_interfaces_comment: What crosses the mainframe boundary and with whom - no source file states the peer. kind: ndm|ftp|mq|ddf|webservice|zosconnect|file|other; direction: in|out|both; one of dataset|queue|table|transaction|program|path. Shown by `interfaces` and on `dataset X`.
